<h1 class="panel-heading ">
    Council Meetings</h1>    
    <!-- For the breadcrumb navigation -->
    <nav class="breadcrumbs rs_skip" aria-label="Breadcrumb navigation links" aria-hidden="true"><ul class="breadcrumb"">

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 26 August</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 23 September </span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 28 October </span></p>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 26 August</p>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>

<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 23 September </span></p>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 26 August</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 23 September </span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 28 October </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 25 November</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;"> 16 December </span></p>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>

<h1 class="panel-heading ">
    Council Meetings</h1>    
    <!-- For the breadcrumb navigation -->
    <nav class="breadcrumbs rs_skip" aria-label="Breadcrumb navigation links" aria-hidden="true"><ul class="breadcrumb"">
<li><a href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au">Home</a>  </li>
<li><a href="/your-shire/">Your Shire</a></li>
<li class="selected">Council Meetings</li>
</ul></nav></div>        
            <div class="main-contents">

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 26 August</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 23 September </span></p>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 26 August</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 23 September </span></p>

<h1 class="panel-heading ">
    Council Meetings</h1>    
    <!-- For the breadcrumb navigation -->
    <nav class="breadcrumbs rs_skip" aria-label="Breadcrumb navigation links" aria-hidden="true"><ul class="breadcrumb"">
<li><a href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au">Home</a>  </li>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 26 August</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 23 September </span></p>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 26 August</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 23 September </span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 28 October </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 25 November</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;"> 16 December </span></p>

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 26 August</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 23 September </span></p>

<h1 class="panel-heading ">

    <!-- For the breadcrumb navigation -->
    <nav class="breadcrumbs rs_skip" aria-label="Breadcrumb navigation links" aria-hidden="true"><ul class="breadcrumb"">

                                            <div class="meetings-intro">
                                <p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the<strong> fourth Wednesday of each month (except January)</strong>.  Meetings will commence at<strong> 4:00 pm</strong> or otherwise stated.</p>
<p>Meetings are held at the Carnamah Council Chambers, 33-37 Macpherson Street, Carnamah.</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Members of the public are welcome to attend. </span></p>
<p>At each meeting there is a public question time near the start of the meeting, where members of the public can ask questions of the Council. <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Anyone wishing to direct a question to Council that may require research is encouraged to fill in a </span><a style="font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-size: 16px;" href="https://www.carnamah.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Public-Question-Time-form.pdf">Public Question Time Form</a><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> and submit at least two days' prior to the meeting so the information can be available at the meeting. </span> If these questions cannot be readily answered during the meeting, the Council will take the question on notice and respond either by letter or at the next meeting.</p>
<p>Audit Committee Meetings are held as required.</p>
<p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>2026 Ordinary Council Meeting Dates</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 25 February</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> <span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;">25 March </span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 400;"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 April</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 27 May</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 24 June</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 22 July</p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span> 26 August</p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 23 September </span></p>
<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 28 October </span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;"> 25 November</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400;">Wednesday</span><span style="font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: common-ligatures; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; font-family: Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;"> 16 December </span></p>
